text:
Elena: Quick escalation 10: marketplace rejected CloudPartner PO due to 'billing_entity_variants' - partner sent 'CloudPartner Netherlands B.V.' but ledger has 'CloudPartner BV'. They're live tomorrow for an in-region launch.

Marco: Do we have a vendor alias for NL entities? I don't recall.

Jules: No alias. Portal enforces exact match. Partner's VAT (NL987654321B01) validated though.

ops_bot: webhook: 422 billing_entity_variants. payload: {"vendor_id":"cp-554","submitted_name":"CloudPartner Netherlands B.V."} (log cpw-1002)

Samir: Finance: can we temporarily accept PDF PO emailed to procure@redwood.com while we sort alias? We need revenue recognized for tomorrow.

Rina: Legal: also saw contract redline where partner removed export-compliance warranty. That one needs legal signoff before accepting PO.

Elena: So two blockers: alias for ingest + legal redline. Partner says legal change is just clarification, not removal, they can reapply original text quickly.

Marco: Ops workaround: add alias cp-554 -> CLOUDPARTNER-BV (internal) and set lenient name-normalization for Netherlands for 48h. I'll need SRE thumbs.

Samir: Finance approves temporary PDF ingestion if alias present and legal confirms redline fix within 24h. We'll mark invoice hold until redline cleared.

Rina: Legal confirmed partner will reapply original clause by EOD. Okay to proceed with conditional acceptance.

ops_bot: alias created cp-554 -> CLOUDPARTNER-BV (actor: marco, time: 1738890100)

Elena: Received signed PO via email. Finance ingested and created invoice draft (INV-3321) with hold note.

Samir: Invoicing allowed but payment release gated on signed confirmation for legal clause; set invoice status = pending-legal.

Jules: Action items: add vendor-alias admin UI and relax NL suffix rules. Opening ticket MKT-4255.

Elena: Launch unblocked for partner tomorrow. Closing escalation, will follow up if legal doesn't return signed clause.
